concerns.text: User Story US3 adds predictive modeling (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, nested k‑fold CV) which was not part of the original research idea. The idea only required statistical association analysis, not supervised prediction, so this extends the scope beyond what was requested.

The performance constraint ('pipeline must complete within 6 hours on a standard CPU') and memory limit are engineering limits not mentioned in the original idea. While reasonable, they constitute additional scope that was not requested and may restrict implementation choices unnecessarily.
